title: Leelawati Devi v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.
disposition: Writ disposed as withdrawn with liberty to appeal under clause 7.10.
headnote: On reconsideration the petitioner sought to withdraw the writ with liberty to file an appeal under Clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench disposed of the writ petition with that liberty. The merits of the electricity dispute were not examined.
facts: Leelawati Devi filed a writ petition against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others. After hearing, counsel for the petitioner on reconsideration prayed to withdraw the writ and sought liberty to file an appeal under Clause 7.10 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench recorded that prayer. The order does not set out the underlying electricity dispute, bill, or grievance.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition may be disposed of as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to file an appeal under Clause 7.10 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
